blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find the function whose graph is shown in the figure.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein graph diya hai aur humein us ka function dhoondna hai; yeh bilkul 1.2 wala kaam hai.
Graph x-axis ko do jagah kaatta hai: \(x = -2\) aur \(x = 1\). Is liye factor form \(a(x - h)(x - k)\) lagegi.
Lekin sirf intercepts se \(a\) maloom nahi hota; is ke liye graph par diya hua teesra point \(\left(\frac{3}{2}, -\frac{7}{4}\right)\) kaam aayega.
Plan: factor form likhna, teesra point rakh kar a nikalna, wapas rakh kar expand karna, aur check karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: x-intercepts \(x = -2\), \(x = 1\); point \(\left(\frac{3}{2}, -\frac{7}{4}\right)\) graph par hai.
Maloom karna: graph ka function.
Tareeqa: \(y = a(x - h)(x - k)\), jahan \(h = -2\), \(k = 1\); phir teesra point rakh kar \(a\) nikalenge.

Factor form likhein
\[y = a(x + 2)(x - 1) \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: \(x = -2\) se factor \((x - (-2)) = (x + 2)\) banta hai, aur \(x = 1\) se \((x - 1)\).
Dhyan dein: negative root ka factor plus wala hota hai; yahan aksar students \((x - 2)\) likh dete hain.

\(a\) nikalein
\[-\dfrac{7}{4} = a\left(\tfrac{3}{2} + 2\right)\left(\tfrac{3}{2} - 1\right)\]
\[-\dfrac{7}{4} = a \cdot \dfrac{7}{2} \cdot \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[-\dfrac{7}{4} = \dfrac{7a}{4}\]
\[a = -1\]
Kyun: point graph par hai, is liye equation (1) ko satisfy karta hai. \(\frac{3}{2} + 2 = \frac{7}{2}\) aur \(\frac{3}{2} - 1 = \frac{1}{2}\). Dono sides ko \(\frac{4}{7}\) se zarb dene par \(a = -1\) mila.
Dhyan dein: fractions ko jaldi mein decimal mat banaiye; \(\frac{7}{4}\) dono taraf hai, is liye fractions mein hi kaam saaf aur aasan rehta hai.

Function likhein
\[y = -(x + 2)(x - 1)\]
\[= -(x^{2} + x - 2)\]
\[y = -x^{2} - x + 2\]
Kyun: \(a = -1\) ko (1) mein rakha aur expand kiya: \((x + 2)(x - 1) = x^{2} - x + 2x - 2 = x^{2} + x - 2\).

Tasdeeq:
\[y(-2) = -(0)(-3) = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y(1) = -(3)(0) = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y\left(\tfrac{3}{2}\right) = -\tfrac{9}{4} - \tfrac{3}{2} + 2 = -\tfrac{7}{4} \;\checkmark\]
\(a = -1 < 0\), yani graph neeche khulta hai, bilkul figure ki tarah. y-intercept \((0, 2)\) bhi figure se milta hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find the function whose graph is shown in the figure.
blocks.explanation:
Yahan bhi graph se function dhoondna hai.
Lekin is graph mein ek khaas baat hai: yeh x-axis ko \(x = 2\) par kaatta nahi, sirf chhoota hai.
Chhoone ka matlab hai repeated root, yani factor \((x - 2)\) do dafa: \(y = a(x - 2)^{2}\) (1.1 ka Case-II).
Phir point \((1, 1)\) se \(a\) nikalenge, aur aakhir mein check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: graph x-axis ko \((2, 0)\) par chhoota hai aur \((1, 1)\) se guzarta hai.
Maloom karna: graph ka function.
Tareeqa: chhoona yani repeated factor, \(y = a(x - h)^{2}\) jahan \(h = 2\); phir \((1, 1)\) rakhenge.

Factor form likhein
\[y = a(x - 2)^{2} \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: jo graph x-axis ko \(x = h\) par sirf chhooye (paar na kare), us mein factor \((x - h)\) do dafa hota hai.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(a(x - 2)(x - k)\) jaisi koi doosri root mat dhoondiye; graph ka x-axis se sirf ek hi milaap hai.

\(a\) nikalein
\[1 = a(1 - 2)^{2}\]
\[1 = a(1) \Rightarrow a = 1\]
Kyun: \((1, 1)\) graph par hai, is liye (1) ko satisfy karta hai. \((1 - 2)^{2} = (-1)^{2} = 1\).
Dhyan dein: \(a\) nikalne ke liye kabhi bhi \((2, 0)\) wala point mat rakhiye; woh \(0 = a \cdot 0\) deta hai jis se \(a\) ke baare mein kuch pata nahi chalta. Hamesha x-axis se bahar wala point lein.

Function likhein
\[y = (x - 2)^{2}\]
\[= x^{2} - 4x + 4\]
Kyun: \(a = 1\) ko (1) mein rakha aur \((p - q)^{2} = p^{2} - 2pq + q^{2}\) se expand kiya.

Tasdeeq:
\[y(2) = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y(1) = (-1)^{2} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
\(a = 1 > 0\): graph upar khulta hai, figure ki tarah. y-intercept \((0, 4)\) bhi figure mein nazar aata hai.
